domain-information: A Bettor reviews upcoming matches and places bets to try to win based on predicted outcomes
A Bettor tracks results and adjusts future bets to improve their chances of winning
An Oddsmaker analyzes team performance, player stats, and past match data to set fair and attractive odds
An Oddsmaker updates odds in real-time when new information affects the expected outcome of a match
A Bookmaker accepts bets from bettors and records wagers to ensure all transactions are tracked
A Bookmaker monitors active bets and settles winnings after matches conclude
A Risk Manager reviews the bookmaker’s exposure to large bets and advises adjustments to minimize potential losses
A Risk Manager monitors trends and unusual betting patterns to prevent fraud and ensure balanced risk

domain objects.name: Bettor

domain objects.name: Result
domain objects.description: final outcome of a match after it concludes

domain objects.name: Oddsmaker
domain objects.description: specialist who analyzes data to set and adjust betting odds

domain objects.name: Performance Statistics
domain objects.description: analytical data describing team or player performance

domain objects.name: Bookmaker

domain objects.name: Winning
domain objects.description: payout owed to a bettor when a bet succeeds

domain objects.name: Wager
domain objects.description: amount staked by a bettor when placing a bet

domain objects.name: Risk Manager

domain objects.name: Data Trends
